discussion_comments.comment_body: This removes inactive preview tabs from the tab order, but this component has no ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/Home/End handler to move focus or select another tab. Please add roving tab keyboard navigation (and a test), otherwise a keyboard-only user can reach only the currently active tab.

Current main moved this placeholder state/effect into `app/chat/composer/hooks/use-composer-placeholder.ts`. When salvaging, carry the locale-change reroll into that hook; its current dependency path only refreshes on a session transition, so switching language in an existing session would otherwise keep the prior placeholder.

Addressed in `bf411a7c4`. The placeholder state now lives in `use-composer-placeholder.ts` as a locale-independent `{ kind, index }`; changing only the language derives the matching text without rerolling or resetting browse history. The new hook test covers existing-session language changes, simultaneous null-to-id persistence, save rollback, and real session changes.
